# BuildCopilot

> Free AI workflows, prompts, templates and guides for UK construction teams, edited by Owen Hagger, a quantity surveyor with 25+ years in UK construction (Contractor Systems).

## Start here
- [AI for quantity surveyors](https://buildcopilot.ai/guides/ai-for-quantity-surveyors-guide): where AI helps a QS and where it doesn't
- [AI cost estimation](https://buildcopilot.ai/guides/ai-construction-estimating): take-off, BoQ, rates and quote comparison
- [AI BIM model checking and QA](https://buildcopilot.ai/guides/ai-bim-model-checking-and-qa)
- [Claude for construction](https://buildcopilot.ai/ai-tools/claude)
- [AI RAMS generator](https://buildcopilot.ai/tools/rams-generator)
